title: Walk-in, the queue and calling a patient in
summary: Register someone with no booking, then run the waiting list.

steps.title: Open the queue
steps.narration: The Queue is your front desk board. Tap it in the menu.

steps.title: Add to queue
steps.narration: Patients move across the board as they wait, go to the chair and finish. To add someone, tap Add to queue.

steps.title: Walk-in or booking
steps.narration: If the patient has a booking today, choose Check in a booking. With no booking, choose Register a walk-in.

steps.title: Mobile number
steps.narration: Start with the mobile number. If the family is already registered, you can pick the right person from the list.

steps.title: Someone new
steps.narration: If nobody has this number yet, tap Someone new to register them.

steps.title: Name
steps.narration: For a new patient, type the name.

steps.title: Age and sex
steps.narration: Add the age in years, and tap the sex. An estimate is fine for age.

steps.title: Reason for visit
steps.narration: Tap the reason for the visit, such as toothache. This is optional but helps the doctor.

steps.title: Health
steps.narration: Next, ask about allergies. Tap the ones the patient has, or tap No known allergies.

steps.title: Consent
steps.narration: Last, take consent. Read the points to the patient, tick them, then tap Add to queue.

steps.title: On the board
steps.narration: The patient now waits on the board with a token number. Booked patients and walk-ins sit in the same list, in the order they arrived.

steps.title: Send to the chair
steps.narration: When the doctor is ready, tap To chair and the patient moves to the In chair column. After the visit they go to Ready to bill, then Done. If someone leaves unseen, tap Left.
